page.overview:
What is Earth Wind and Fire?

Like all abilities directly conferring supernatural powers to their users, Earth Wind and Fire doesn't actually possess a physical form: instead, it is bound to its user's body.

As a result of Mikitaka's self-proclaimed alien identity, there is speculation regarding the true nature of Earth Wind and Fire and its origin. Due to the circumstances surrounding Mikitaka and the author's own purposeful ambiguity, it is currently unknown if it is an alien ability or a Stand. A notable point to this discussion is the fact that Mikitaka seems to not be able to see Stands, like when Josuke uses Crazy Diamond to test this very property. Since all Stand Users can see Stands, Mikitaka either acts as though he cannot see them (which he has very little reason to do), or truly can't. In that case, Earth Wind and Fire is not a Stand Ability.

Mikitaka's Earth Wind and Fire is a harmless shapeshifting power whose usefulness is mitigated by Mikitaka's eccentricity.

Earth Wind and Fire allows Mikitaka to transform into any object.
